scene_description: A girl in a red sweater is decorating a Christmas tree by hanging a candy cane ornament. An adult hand is helping her. In the background, two other children stand near the decorated tree, which has red and gold ornaments and colorful lights.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big green tree with decorations on it.

questions.evidence_hint: Think about what people do after they finish decorating a Christmas tree.
